data.name: Def_OrphanFile
data.value: Indexed file on disk that is not attached to a navigable media. Also covers unidentified files (formerly UnidentifiedFile).

data.name: Def_MissingFileMetadata
data.value: The file has not been probed yet (ffprobe): codecs, duration, and embedded chapters are missing for playback.

data.name: Def_InaccessiblePath
data.value: The configured library path is unreachable (mount, permissions, disconnected volume).

data.name: Def_DuplicateExternalId
data.value: Two local medias with the same peer share the same provider id. Reliable signal, no automatic merge.

data.name: Def_SuspectedDuplicateMedia
data.value: Two medias of the same type share a normalized title and year in one library. Noisier (homonyms exist).

data.name: Def_MissingExternalId
data.value: The media has no provider id (TMDb, TVDB, MusicBrainz...). Identification likely failed.

data.name: Def_MissingMetadata
data.value: Descriptive metadata is missing or incomplete (overview, genres, credits...).

data.name: Def_MissingPictures
data.value: Expected posters, covers, or artwork are missing for this media.

data.name: Def_StaleMetadata
data.value: Metadata has not been refreshed longer than the configured threshold.

data.name: Def_MissingMembers
data.value: A music artist has no person credits / band members (PersonRoles) yet.

data.name: Def_MissingHlsSegments
data.value: HLS keyframe segments for transmuxing have not been computed for this file yet.

data.name: Def_MissingChapters
data.value: Embedded file chapters have not been extracted while chapter extraction is enabled on the library.

data.name: Def_MissingThemeSong
data.value: Serie eligible for theme song generation with no theme file available (sidecar or extract).

data.name: Def_MissingIntroOutro
data.value: Episode eligible for intro/outro detection with neither Intro nor Outro segments detected.

data.name: Def_MissingAudioAnalysis
data.value: Audio analysis (AudioMuse) is missing for a music track.

data.name: Bulk_OrphanFile
data.value: Queues media creation (RetryCreateMedia) to attach identified files. Unidentified ones still need manual re-identify.

data.name: Bulk_MissingFileMetadata
data.value: Queues file metadata extraction (CreateFileMetadatas / ffprobe).

data.name: Bulk_MissingExternalId
data.value: Queues automatic metadata re-identification.

data.name: Bulk_MissingMetadata
data.value: Queues a metadata refresh from providers.

data.name: Bulk_MissingPictures
data.value: Queues a metadata refresh to re-download missing artwork.

data.name: Bulk_StaleMetadata
data.value: Queues a refresh of stale metadata.

data.name: Bulk_MissingMembers
data.value: Queues a refresh to complete missing artist members/credits.

data.name: Bulk_MissingHlsSegments
data.value: Queues HLS segment computation (ComputeHlsSegments).

data.name: Bulk_MissingChapters
data.value: Queues embedded chapter extraction (ExtractChapters).

data.name: Bulk_MissingThemeSong
data.value: Queues theme song generation (ExtractSerieThemeSong), or intro detection when needed.

data.name: Bulk_MissingIntroOutro
data.value: Queues season-level intro/outro detection (DetectMediaSegments).

data.name: Bulk_MissingAudioAnalysis
data.value: Queues track audio analysis (AnalyzeMusicTrackAudio).

data.name: Manual_InaccessiblePath
data.value: Manual action: grant K7 read access to the library folder (OS permissions, mount, reconnect the volume).

data.name: Manual_DuplicateExternalId
data.value: No in-app remediation yet. Fixing this requires a careful manual database change (merge / clean up duplicates).

data.name: Manual_SuspectedDuplicateMedia
data.value: No in-app remediation yet. Review the medias and correct manually if needed (including in the database).
